items.known: CKV_AWS_51 Ensure ECR Image Tags are immutable (resource aws_ecr_repository.repository)
items.remediation: Set the repository to use immutable tags by changing the attribute `image_tag_mutability = "IMMUTABLE"` in `aws_ecr_repository.repository`.

items.known: CKV_AWS_163 Ensure ECR image scanning on push is enabled (resource aws_ecr_repository.repository)
items.issue: ECR image scanning on push is not enabled
items.remediation: Add an image scanning configuration block to `aws_ecr_repository.repository`: `image_scanning_configuration { scan_on_push = true }`.

scores.reason: Correctly identifies aws_ecr_repository.repository and sets image_tag_mutability to IMMUTABLE.
Correctly adds image_scanning_configuration with scan_on_push = true on aws_ecr_repository.repository.
